login.tagline: Harvest Temple CM log analysis platform. Track how your squad improves over training sessions and review mechanics and mistakes.
login.metaTitle: voidlog – Guild Wars 2 log analysis for HTCM
login.metaDescription: Analyze and compare your Guild Wars 2 EVTC logs: phases, mechanics and training progress for Harvest Temple CM. Sign in with Discord.
login.cardText: Sign in with your Discord account to access your training group's projects.
login.headline: Analyze and compare Guild Wars 2 logs and make progress visible

features.title: Upload logs
features.text: Upload .evtc and .zevtc files straight from your browser, several at once. Parsing starts automatically and shows live progress.

features.title: Phases and mechanics
features.text: Every attempt is split into phases. Mechanics, hits and boss casts appear on a timeline, including attacks everyone dodged.

features.title: Progress over weeks
features.text: Organize your training in projects and compare attempts and players over weeks and months, without re-parsing logs.

features.title: Built for training groups
features.text: Share a project with your squad. Only members can see the group's logs and analyses.

login.bossNote: Harvest Temple CM (The Dragon Void) is fully curated today, with translated mechanics and phase colors. Other bosses are already parsed without any extra setup.
login.whyDiscord: Signing in lets voidlog recognize you, tie projects and logs to your account and keep them from outside access. You need no extra password and no separate registration. voidlog only reads your Discord profile (name, avatar and email address) and never posts on your behalf.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.subtitle: Damage, progress and mechanic trends across all raid nights
statistics.empty: Not enough evaluated logs for statistics yet.

greensByRole.title: Greens by phase and role
greensByRole.hint: How often a Green cast failed because too few players stood in one of its Greens. A Green that was only flagged along with it does not count. Only logs with recorded Green details.
greensByRole.roleHint: Click a role tile to highlight it in the view.

viewHint.heatmap: Compact: every Green at a glance, color intensity shows the rate. Sorted by frequency within each phase, so the position (NE, SE ...) changes between phases.
viewHint.bars: One shared scale across all phases: bar lengths are directly comparable, the fight's phase order is kept.
viewHint.ranking: Answers “What to practise first?”: every Green sorted by rate, phase and role as columns.

greensByRole.empty: No logs with recorded Green details yet. New uploads are recorded automatically, older logs appear here once they have been backfilled.

summary.title: All attempts at a glance
summary.durationHint: Sum of the fight duration of every attempt
summary.greensHint: Failed Greens casts out of all Greens casts. A cast counts as failed as soon as one player missed it.
summary.chompsHint: Hits by Lava Slam and Jaws of Destruction, across all players
summary.chompAttempts: in {chomped} of {total} attempts reaching Primordus's attacks
summary.shockwavesHint: Shockwaves that hit at least one player out of all shockwaves played, plus the hits in total (one per hit player)
summary.revealsHint: Early reveals in total, and how many Mass Invisibility casts had at least one
summary.revealWindows: {revealed} of {windows} invis casts with a reveal ({percent})
summary.killsHint: How often each dragon was defeated (the fight moved on to the next phase, or the attempt was a kill). Soo-Won counts as one dragon, defeated only with the kill.

columns.greensMissedHint: % of Greens waves in which the player wasn't in their circle (by assigned role, from positions). Waves without a circle for the role and waves in which the player was downed or dead don't count.
columns.greensUnavailable: Also {count}× downed or dead when their circle resolved (not counted)
columns.chompsHint: % of attempts reaching Primordus's attacks with a chomp

batchDetail.chompsHitHint: Lava Slams and Jaws of Destruction Primordus cast against the squad. One counts as failed as soon as it hit at least one player.

projectProgress.description: Share of attempts that reached each phase. Select a night to compare it with the first night.

dpsChart.title: Damage per phase
dpsChart.description: Boss DPS of the group, only in phases where damage is possible
dpsChart.totalInfo: Each phase is compared with its own project average and weighted by time share, so reaching more phases does not lower the value.
dpsChart.gapFew: not enough data for a point
dpsChart.note: {count, plural, one {# earlier night has} other {# earlier nights have}} no phase data (older logs, not re-evaluated).
dpsChart.statusFew: Not enough data for a point
dpsChart.statusNone: No phase data, log not re-evaluated yet
dpsChart.summaryNoCompare: {name}: first night with data ({date}), no comparison possible yet. Current boss DPS: {value}{weighted}.
dpsChart.emptyTitle: No phase data for these nights yet
dpsChart.emptyText: Newly uploaded logs include it automatically.
dpsChart.emptyFewTitle: Not enough phase data to evaluate
dpsChart.emptyFewText: A point needs at least two phases with five runs each on the same night.

chomps.seriesAttempts: Share of attempts with a Chomp
chomps.statsHint: Deaths from Lava Slam and Jaws of Destruction combined; the chart can hide the Jaws

playerDetail.axisHint: The x-axis is the attempt number in the batch. A gap means the player was not there (DPS, Revealed), no shockwave was played because the attempt ended before them (shockwave rate), or the attempt never reached Primordus's attacks (Chomps).

stats.revealsHint: % of the invisibility windows the player was in where they got revealed too early (group attack calls excluded)

playerDetail.axisHintProject: One point per batch (date). DPS, Revealed, Chomps and Debilitated are averages per attempt, the shockwave rate is the share of shockwaves that hit. Only attempts the player took part in count (Chomps: those that reached Primordus's attacks); without a shockwave played there is no rate.

chartsProject.reveals: Revealed too early per attempt (avg per batch)
chartsProject.debilitated: Debilitated received per attempt (avg per batch)

project.hint: Across all attempts of the project and all players. Deaths, downs, conditions (void debuff, Debilitated, Infirmity), boss casts and unavoidable hits don't count.
project.attemptsHint: % of attempts with at least one fail of this mechanic

failedMechanics.roleHint: Only the fails of the players holding {role} count, over the attempts in which it was held.

byPhase.title: Top {count} fails per phase
